notes:
Teacher 1.20.8, console 2.3.28, teacher laptop 1.0.0.
- A teacher is never left with an empty app: your saved id is now a hint, not the truth. The app finds you again by cloud id, then phone number, then name, and puts you back on your classes. The Classes screen has 'Find my classes' if it ever comes back empty.
- Send marks without a cloud account: the class bundle is written to a file and handed to WhatsApp. The head teacher imports it on the console with one tap.
- Paper leaves the phone: report previews and the class marksheet export as real Word files, named after the class and term, printed in the school's own form (No. | NAME | A2 | A3 | X/20 | X/80 | X/100).
- The laptop teacher app now rules its sheet the same way: A2 20% + A3 80%, with X/20 and X/80 shown, and its installer finally ships with this release.
- Fixed a crash when a school with an uploaded logo exported a report on Android.
- Fixed the double space in every name that had a blank middle name.
